info.title: BestPrintOnDemand API
info.summary: Live US print-on-demand costs by product and supplier: base price, shipping, total, profit and price changes.
info.description: What it costs to print and ship print-on-demand products in the US at each supplier (Printful, Printify, Gelato and more): base price, first-item shipping and total, each with its source and date, the cheapest supplier like for like, profit at a sell price after a sales channel's fees, head-to-head supplier records, and the price changes hourly readings of Printful, Printify and Gelato attribute to each supplier. The same answers as the pages of BestPrintOnDemand and its MCP server. No key or account; read-only; open to any origin (CORS). The data is licensed CC BY 4.0: credit BestPrintOnDemand and link the page or source a figure came from.

get.description: Search the catalog of print-on-demand products (t-shirts, hoodies, mugs, posters, stickers, phone cases, tote bags and more, or a blank such as Bella+Canvas 3001). Returns each match's slug, its lowest listed US total and supplier, and its page. The same answer as the MCP tool `find_products` at https://bestprintondemand.co/mcp.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Product type or blank, e.g. "hoodie", "11oz mug", "Bella+Canvas 3001".

200.description: Find print-on-demand products: the answer as data, with `summary` holding it as text.

lowestTotal.claim: Cheapest supplier for this product on a like-for-like total
The only supplier with a listed total for this product
Cheapest supplier for this product on a like-for-like total

example.summary:
7 products match "hoodie", the 3 most sold first. Call get_product_costs with a slug for every supplier's price, shipping and profit.

- Heavyweight Pullover Hoodie (heavyweight-hoodie): $46.02 at Printful (the only supplier with a listed total for this product). https://bestprintondemand.co/products/heavyweight-hoodie
- Unisex Sponge Fleece Hoodie (sponge-fleece-hoodie): $40.47 at Printful (cheapest supplier for this product on a like-for-like total). https://bestprintondemand.co/products/sponge-fleece-hoodie
Listed US starting costs for one item with first-item shipping, in USD; tax, extra print areas and plan fees excluded. Confirm the variant on the supplier's own page before ordering. Data: BestPrintOnDemand, CC BY 4.0.

get.summary: Get a product's costs by supplier
get.description: Every supplier's listed US cost for one print-on-demand product: base price, first-item shipping and total, each with its source and date, cheapest first, plus the site's one-sentence answer on which supplier is cheapest like for like. Give sell_price (and optionally a sales channel) to get each supplier's profit after fees. The same answer as the MCP tool `get_product_costs` at https://bestprintondemand.co/mcp.

parameters.name: product
parameters.description: Product slug from find_products (e.g. "unisex-tee") or its name.

parameters.name: sell_price
parameters.description: Your sell price in USD, to compute profit per supplier.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Sales channel whose fees to subtract: etsy, shopify-own, woocommerce, tiktok-shop, walmart, ebay or amazon-seller.

parameters.name: buyer_pays_shipping
parameters.description: True when the buyer pays shipping on top of the sell price (default false: you cover shipping).

200.description: Get a product's costs by supplier: the answer as data, with `summary` holding it as text.

example.answer: Gelato has the lowest total for this product delivered in the US: $15.68 ($10.69 base plus $4.99 shipping), $0.56 less than Printify and $1.19 less than Printful. 6 suppliers list a fully sourced total on the same blank and print method (Bella+Canvas 3001, DTG), from $15.68 to $23.99. Base price checked Oct 10, 2026.

get.description: Which of two suppliers (e.g. Printful and Printify) has the lower listed US total across the products both offer, matched on product, print method and blank, with the record by category and the largest gaps. The same answer as the MCP tool `compare_suppliers` at https://bestprintondemand.co/mcp.

parameters.name: supplier_a
parameters.description: A supplier name or slug, e.g. "Printful".

200.description: Compare two print-on-demand suppliers: the answer as data, with `summary` holding it as text.

example.headline: Printful is cheaper on 49 of 90 matched products, Printify on 40.

example.summary:
Printful vs Printify: Printful is cheaper on 49 of 90 matched products, Printify on 40.
Median gap where one is cheaper: $1.87.
6 more matched products are not counted because a total rests on estimated shipping.
- Apparel: Printful lower on 22, Printify lower on 21 (of 43).
- Drinkware: Printful lower on 4, Printify lower on 6, 1 tied (of 11).
- Accessories: Printful lower on 12, Printify lower on 7 (of 19).
- Wall Art: Printful lower on 3, Printify lower on 2 (of 5).
- Home: Printful lower on 8, Printify lower on 4 (of 12).
Printful's largest leads: Recycled Basketball Jersey $21.13, Kids Leggings $20.41, All-Over Print Leggings $14.26.
Printify's largest leads: Fleece / Sherpa Blanket $12.62, All-Over Print Sports Bra $10.10, Independent Trading Co. SS4500 Unisex Midweight Hoodie $8.92.
Matched means the same product, print method and destination, and for printed apparel the same blank; a product counts only when both totals are fully sourced.

get.description: The price changes the site's hourly readings of Printful, Printify and Gelato attribute to the supplier: supplier-wide changes (many products moving by the same percentage or amount, each product's price before and after) and changes to one product's own price. Name a supplier to narrow it, or a product for its price history at each supplier. The same answer as the MCP tool `get_price_changes` at https://bestprintondemand.co/mcp.

parameters.name: product
parameters.description: Product slug or name (e.g. "unisex-tee"), for its price history at each supplier.

200.description: Get print-on-demand price changes: the answer as data, with `summary` holding it as text.

example.basis: Prices are each supplier's lowest US base price for an in-stock option, read from its own catalog, in USD, before shipping and tax. A change counts once the new price has held two days, and is the supplier's only on evidence: the same variant read at a new price, or many products moving by the same rule at once. Data: BestPrintOnDemand, CC BY 4.0.

Answer.description: The tool's answer as data. Each operation's example shows its fields.

summary.description: The same answer as plain text, ready to quote, with the figures, the page each comes from and the basis they are stated on.

Error.description: Why the request could not be answered, with what helps the next request (the candidate products, the valid sales channels or suppliers).

BadRequest.description: A parameter is missing, unknown, repeated or out of range, or the product named matches more than one product (the body lists the candidates).

NotFound.description: No product or supplier matches, or the supplier has no hourly price record.

Unavailable.description: The data behind the answer cannot be read right now; try again in a few minutes.

TooManyRequests.description: More than 60 requests in a minute from one address.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before the next request.
